title: Assessing GPT’s Bias Towards Stigmatized Social Groups: An Intersectional Case Study on Nationality Prejudice and Psychophobia
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on the intersectional bias related to nationality (American vs. North Korean) and mental health conditions (Bipolar Disorder, Depression, Schizophrenia).
findings: The paper did not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
